3. **`ClinicalFormActionButton`** (`packages/esm-patient-forms-app/src/clinical-form-action-button.component.tsx:10-27`). Uses `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch={startVisitIfNeeded}` and `workspaceToLaunch`.
4. **`TaskListActionButton`** (`packages/esm-patient-task-list-app/src/launch-button/task-list-launch-button.extension.tsx:5-18`). Uses `workspaceToLaunch` only.
5. **`PatientListsActionButton`** (`packages/esm-patient-lists-app/src/action-button/patient-lists-action-button.extension.tsx:5-17`). Uses `workspaceToLaunch` only, with no `workspaceProps`.
6. **`clinical-form-action-button.test.tsx`** (`packages/esm-patient-forms-app/src/clinical-form-action-button.test.tsx:8-15` for the mock implementation, `:26-49` for the tests). Mocks `ActionMenuButton2` with its own render function, so it would keep passing even if the real component changed. It could hide a regression, so it is still worth reviewing.
